correctness.rationale: The standalone exact verifier generates 35,218 independent faces and all 205,656 codimension-one incidences. A full topological sort establishes acyclicity of 17,604 selected pairs, with one critical vertex, six five-cells and three six-cells. The 6-by-3 integral Morse matrix has two unit invariant factors and primitive kernel (1,-1,1), giving torsion-free ranks 4 and 1. The explicitly lifted 696-term integral top cycle has zero boundary; its rotation projects to the negative of its generator, proving top trace -1. All twelve signed fixed-face Lefschetz sums are checked, yielding degree-five regular quotient-four character. No finite sample is extrapolated to an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The Nauru graph is a canonical 24-vertex symmetric cubic graph with an intrinsic order-twelve rotation; a complete rational symmetry representation of its independence-complex homology is a natural invariant not fixed by the known nonequivariant homotopy type. The result proves the non-obvious order-three rotational kernel on rational homology and identifies invariant cycles, the sign line, and the complete four-dimensional quotient-four permutation module. This is a motivated equivariant refinement of the exact graph, not a parameter-tuned numerical slice.
